scope: S11/N4c synthetic test-only Model to Paper execution gate

default_gate.allowed_environment: APP_ENV=test, explicit forecast fixture flag, disposable SQLite URL matching Database settings

positive_fixture.source: sealed synthetic forecast and proposal with verified artifact and approval
positive_fixture.quantity_policy: Decimal 10.9 rounded down to 10 by volUnit=1
positive_fixture.paper_path: ModelPaperService -> PaperService.submit -> PaperService risk -> estimated Paper fill
positive_fixture.same_service_concurrent_replay: same stored result, no extra intent/order/fill
positive_fixture.restart_replay: same stored result, no extra intent/order/fill

negative_fixtures: WAIT or unsealed forecast, missing approval, corrupt artifact, mismatched outcome/rules, expired approval, stale forecast and disabled gate: zero Paper intent/order/fill
min/max quantity outside contract: zero Paper intent/order/fill
kill, stale market, stale worker and stale rules: one REJECT intent/verdict but zero order/fill
UNKNOWN existing order: zero new intent/order/fill
limitations: Synthetic forecast clock override and current synthetic Paper market snapshots do not prove real forward event-time execution.
Race was exercised within one service instance; cross-process ModelPaper orchestration race was not tested.
Real MEXC news data-use rights, model forward gate and Stage 8 operational gate remain open.
No production route, scheduler, approval or automatic Paper activation exists.
